title: Execution lease materializer
goal: Materialize an admitted execution authorization as a short-lived package-bound lease without launching the worker.
laws: Lease requires an exact READY_NOT_EXECUTING build package and admitted DECK-EXEC receipt.
Package SHA-256, builder ID, build request ID and mission ID are immutable lease bindings.
Lease lifetime is deterministic from authorization receivedAt and expires after ten minutes.
Expired or mismatched authorization fails closed.
Lease status is LEASE_READY_NOT_STARTED; authorityGranted and executionStarted remain false.
No model, worker, shell mutation, or product mutation is started.
